description: Na₄Zn₃S₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.69-2.81 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five S atoms to form distorted NaS₅ square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four ZnS₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaS₅ square pyramids, and edges with four ZnS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-54°. There are three shorter (2.95 Å) and two longer (3.01 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaS₅ square pyramids, corners with five ZnS₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with five ZnS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.12 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.78-2.95 Å. There are three inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to four S atoms to form ZnS₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₅ square pyramids, corners with six ZnS₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaS₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 15°. There is one shorter (2.39 Å) and three longer (2.40 Å) Zn-S bond lengths. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to four S atoms to form ZnS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₅ square pyramids, corners with six ZnS₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. There are a spread of Zn-S bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.49 Å. In the third Zn site, Zn is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted ZnS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with six ZnS₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. There are a spread of Zn-S bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.48 Å. There are five inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Zn atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na and two equivalent Zn atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six Na and two Zn atoms. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Na and three Zn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Zn₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 72°. In the fifth S site, S is bonded to three Na and three Zn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Zn₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 72°.
